run_test_image: run the test_image script to display live camera frames from a Digit360 device using OpenCV
run_get_digit360_devices: run get_digit360_devices to discover and list all connected Digit360 USB devices on the system
run_Digit360Descriptor: run code that uses Digit360Descriptor to access a device's serial, data port, audio, and camera paths
run_cv2_VideoCapture: run cv2.VideoCapture with a Digit360 descriptor's ICS path to read live camera frames
run_Digit360_read: run Digit360.read to read and decode a Digit360Message frame from the device's serial port
